purpose: Canonical responsibility boundary between LOC4 Writing and LOC6 Governance. The distinction is source text vs governance/style interpretation, not platform vs document.
core_rule: 原始作者文字歸 LOC4；由原始文字產生的治理、價值觀、政德風、風格狀態與治理解讀歸 LOC6。跨域只能 reference / consume，不得改寫另一方的 canonical ownership。

creative_works.label: 創作作品
owned_records: theme-song/cross-media references attached to the work

must_not_own: 符文到治理語意的 interpretation

owns: 人生觀／價值觀的治理化表述
由 LOC4 原文萃取後經確認的治理／風格分析
must_not_own: 一般作品級／章級文學語意解析

projection_rules.requirement: LOC6 record must keep source_refs back to LOC4/source corpus.
LOC6 may add governance meaning but must not overwrite LOC4 work analysis.
raw post stays LOC4; derived style profile/statement stays LOC6.

search_rules: 搜尋 Facebook/Threads 原文時 primary_loc = LOC4。
搜尋小說／文章原文與一般作品解析時 primary_loc = LOC4。
搜尋政德風、價值觀、治理原則、style-state 或 governance interpretation 時 primary_loc = LOC6。
同一 query 可同時回傳 LOC4 原文證據與 LOC6 解讀，但兩者必須是不同 records。
storage_rule: Storage path does not define ownership. Historical generated files may remain under a legacy loc6 path temporarily, but metadata/primary_loc must follow this registry until physical path migration is separately performed.
